Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Blog2" /> an '''incident''' occurred at the abandoned [[lidium]] [[Mining/Legends|mine]] [[Mesa 291]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agent [[Tay Vanis]] arranged to meet several new recruits at the facility, but they were tracked by [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] officer [[Mar Barezz]] and a force of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. The new recruits had to fight through the stormtroopers to rendezvous with Vanis, reach their ships, and escape.<ref name="Breakout" />
